fact: Gavi's programme audit, carried out in August 2024, states that DHIS2 has been used exclusively since January 2024 on a November 2023 instruction of the Secretary-General of the health ministry, and that in a district it visited the district EPI manager receives the monthly activity reports of 16 health centres and keys them into DHIS2 at district level.
title: Rapport d'audit des programmes : République du Tchad
